| R-9 | **Raw TCP clients open one connection per call** (e.g. `invoke-tcp-command.ps1`, apply_look). | Every call gets a new `conn:N` owner, which means limiter key churn (collapsed), `NoteDeprecatedParam` unbounded per (cmd, param, owner), and presence never counting it. A per-call `lease_acquire` defaults `bind_connection:true`, so the lease is orphaned after each reply and lapses 60 s later (T7). An agent PIE started this way has an unmatchable owner. | T4.2, T6, T7, T2 | Collapse and cap `NoteDeprecatedParam`. The ladder runs a per-call pass explicitly. The lease_acquire `next` hint tells per-call clients to use `bind_connection:false` or a persistent socket. |
| R-10 | **Node restart changes the owner** (`node-<pid>-<rand>` when `HAYBA_AGENT_ID` is unset). | The old bound leases orphan and lapse after 60 s and cannot be revived (owner mismatch). The keeper's tracked ids are lost. An agent PIE becomes unmatchable (the stop-from-anyone rule covers it). Per-owner Plan approval is lost. | T7.3, T2 | Add a keeper test: restart with the same `HAYBA_AGENT_ID`, then `renewAllByOwner()` revives the orphans. Document `HAYBA_AGENT_ID` as required in the handoffs. |
| R-11 | **PIE starts mid-batch, or a PIE request is queued between steps.** | `bHeld` must also see `IsPlaySessionRequestQueued()`. A `CollectGarbage` action chosen on the same tick PIE is queued must not run. A user Play while the batch holds loaded WP regions duplicates a heavy world. The batch lease keeps renewing through a 30-minute PIE and blocks others. | T2.4 | `BatchHoldsDuringPIE` covers a queued request, not only a running one. The status reports `busy:"pie"` and `held_s`. |
| R-12 | **Read-like registered commands are refused by default** (neither in PieSafe nor in any Read set): `wait_for_idle`, `wait_for_shaders`, `asset_validate`, `material_validate`, `mesh_audit`, `mesh_list_dynamic`, `mesh_topology_stats`, `metasound_inspect`, `metasound_list`, `pcg_export_graph`, `pcg_read_node_output`, `pcg_validate_graph`, `placement_validate`, `scene_export`, `scene_validate_physics`, `texture_audit`, `ui_measure_text`, `copilot_get_key`. | From Deploy A they get `pie_active` during any user Play. After T8 they are WriteScoped (and `lease_conflict`) whenever another owner holds global X. Host scripts that `wait_for_idle` while the user plays break. | T2.3, T8.2 | **Decided 2026-09-28** (spec, "Maintainer decisions added 2026-09-28"): all 18 are reads. T2.3 adds them to `ReadCommands()` (53 → 71). `PieSafeDrift` and `ReadClassDrift` assert that none of them is refused during PIE or classified as a write. |
| R-13 | **`IPIEAuthorizer` details** (C19, C11). | The methods are `const`, so the double-press state lives in `FHaybaMCPEditorState`. `IsPIEAuthorizedInternal` is pure virtual on 5.8. A denied request is cancelled by the engine, so CancelPIE arrives with no BeginPIE and the tracker must not count two ends. The 5.7 branch is unverifiable. | T2.2, T10.1 | `PieTracker` gets a case: `PreBegin` then `Cancel` gives `EndSerial+1` once. |
| R-14 | **Hooks under owned children.** | `Startup()` must be outside `if (!bOwnedAutomationChild …)` and before `StartTcpServer`. Otherwise `HooksBoundAtStartup` passes in the GUI and fails in children, or the reverse. | T2.2 | `HooksBoundAtStartup` runs in a child. |
| R-15 | **Python corruption markers can be forged.** | `raise SystemError("unknown opcode")` or `print("Fatal Python error")` from any agent makes the editor sticky-unsafe until restart. That is a denial-of-service vector and a false-positive source, for example a script that reads an old log. | T1.3 | Scan LogPython **Error** lines and the text of an exception whose type is exactly the built-in `SystemError` (read through `BaseException.__getattribute__`, first argument only, a `str` only, at most 240 characters); never stdout, stderr or a subclass. Name the matched marker in the Error line. An agent that can run Python can still forge a marker (`unreal.log_error`, or raising the exact type): that costs a restart, never data, and refusing to scan would hide the real I-6 signature. The GA.2 ladder uses the LogPython path on purpose as its live trigger, on a throwaway host only. |
| R-16 | **Read-only package variants.** | `.uexp`, `.ubulk`, `.uptnl` or `.m.ubulk` read-only while `.uasset` is writable. A `.umap` vs `SaveAndVerify`'s `.uasset` path (C12). OFPA `__ExternalActors__` packages in `level_save`. Engine or plugin content under a read-only install. A missing file (new asset) must **not** count as read-only. Only the `.umap` read-only while the external actors are writable. | T5.1, T5.2 | `FindReadOnlyPackageFiles` cases for each. `LevelSaveRefusesWithoutModal` covers a read-only external package. |
| R-17 | **Preflight order.** | UI `ReconcileWidgetVariableGuids` mutates GUIDs, `material_set_param` calls `Modify()`, `create_graph` renames a same-name graph into transient (`:654-658`). A late preflight plus an observed mutation turns `policy_blocked` into `session_suspect`. | T5.2 | `save-site-contract` asserts `RefuseIfReadOnly(TEXT("<cmd>")` precedes the first mutation token in each named function. |
| R-18 | **Log floods and drains.** A user PIE during a bpgraph build (25–35 calls/s); unsafe refusal storms; lease warnings. | `DrainExpired()` runs only on the next `Note`, so the last window's "repeated N more times" may never print, and M2 undercounts. | T1.1, T6.2 | Call `DrainExpired()` at every log site. Also add a 30 s core-ticker drain owned by `FHaybaMCPLeaseManager` (**ledger decision**). `ProcessingLogOwner` covers the drain line. |
| R-19 | **Existing grep contracts** (C13, C14). | `seh-postprocessing-gate.test.ts:35` and `audit-crash-threat-model.mjs:60` fail open or fail when the wording changes. 14 test files scan the router. | T1.5 (and every router task) | Teach each check the new form in the same commit. Run the whole vitest suite after each router edit. |
| R-20 | **`EHaybaFaultSite` scope.** | If the enum sits in `namespace HaybaSeh`, the source literal becomes `RunGuardedAt(HaybaSeh::EHaybaFaultSite::Python`, and T5's contract (`RunGuardedAt(EHaybaFaultSite::Python`) fails. | T1.2 | Declare it at global scope, in T1.1's `Public/HaybaMCPSeh.h` hunk. |
| R-21 | **`editor_get_state` size.** | After T1–T3 the reply has 18–19 top-level fields against `MaxTopLevelFields = 20`. A later field drops silently in lexical order. | T2.3 | `GetStateShape` asserts every field. Add a per-command limit (32, like `asset_import`) in the router. |
| R-22 | **`pie_running` compatibility** (C20). | `IsPlaySessionInProgress` includes `IsPlayingSessionInEditor`, which may be stale after a Standalone launch. | T2.3 | Derive `pie_running` from `ResolvePie`. |
| R-23 | **Asset-busy lifetimes.** | Before T7, bpgraph's bound lease dies after 5 s idle, so `asset_busy` protection is lost mid-build unless the host pings every 2 s. After T7, an orphaned asset lease keeps `asset_busy` (and refuses `editor_start_pie`) for up to 60 s after bpgraph dies. `AnyBusyCommands` counts the caller's own build. | T3, T7 | Handoff A text; `RouterAssetBusyStartPie` includes the caller-owned case. |
| R-24 | **Undeclared `python_run` in `editor_batch` steps** (the M3 WP bulk-edit pattern). | Under EnforcedForWrites, a step conflicts with any other owner's lease, including asset leases. The batch fails at that step and unloads. | T8.2 | Add an `EnforcedForWritesTwoOwners` case: a batch `python_run` step with `resources` declared passes. Document it in handoff B. |
| R-25 | **The `ConnId 0` double meaning in `Renew`.** | On a bound, live lease, 0 means "leave the binding" (batch keep-alive). On an orphan, it means "unbind". Mixing them up re-binds a batch lease to 0, or leaves an orphan capped. | T7.1 | `RenewRevivesOrphanedLeaseOfSameOwner` plus a case where the batch keep-alive leaves a bound lease bound. |
| R-26 | **A settings ini masks the default.** | A `DefaultHaybaMCP.ini` on the scratch or dev host with `LeaseEnforcement=Advisory` would hide the T8 default. The UENUM insertion also changes numeric values. | T8.1 | `lease-enforcement-contract.test.ts` checks the C++ default literal. `EnforcedForWritesTwoOwners` sets and restores the mode explicitly. Grep for numeric uses. The scratch host has no `DefaultHaybaMCP.ini`. |
| R-27 | **The batch owner is `conn:N` after T9.** | The reserved-owner rule would refuse every step, and keep refusing after connection N closes. | T9.1 | `ProcessBatchStep(…, BatchOwner)`; slot 0 is skipped when `BatchJobId` is set (`ReservedOwner` case). |
| R-28 | **The `lease_adopt` layers** (C7, C8). | The Node `executeCommand('lease_adopt')` without the C++ registration fails `wire-command-names.test.ts`. The category listing has no lease domain. | T9.2 | One commit carries C++ plus Node plus the descriptor. Decide layer 5 explicitly. |
| R-29 | **Old gate or new plugin in the transition** (§4.4). | `KeyError` at `editor_gate.py:273` leaves a global X `bind_connection:false` lease that blocks everyone for up to 900 s. | T4.4, T7.2 | Handoff B spells out the recovery `lease_release {all:true}` with the owner. The host kit test `test_plugin_without_lease_id_capability_keeps_the_file_lock`. |
| R-30 | **New `.cpp` omitted on the first build.** | T1, T2, T4, T5, T6, T7 and T9 all add translation units. | all | Build twice after adding files, or check `Automation List` names in the log, before judging. |

#### A.5.2 When to build C++

- **Per sub-task** (T1.x …): run the TS gate always. For C++, iterate on the scratch host with **targeted** runs: exact full names joined by `+`, for example `RunTests Hayba.MCP.Health.ClassifyCaughtFault+Hayba.MCP.Health.UnsafeGatePolicy`. `AutomationCommandline.cpp:135` splits on `+`. A targeted run is never a gate.
- **Per task tip** (T1.6, T2.6, T3.3, T4.5, T5.4, T6.3, T7.4, T8.4, T9.3; T10 folds into GB.1):
  1. Sync.
  2. Full host build.
  3. A second build if any `.cpp` was added.
  4. Full headless `RunTests Hayba`.
  5. `check-automation-report` against the manifest.
  6. TS gate.
- **Deploy gates** (GA/GB/GC): all of the above, plus `RunUAT BuildPlugin` (strict, standalone), plus the GUI live ladder, plus the handoff.
- **Parallel C++ lanes need separate scratch hosts** (`D:/UEScratch/h58`, `h58b`, …). Intermediate files and UBT's mutex are shared per project. Never run two headless editors on one project, and never drive the GUI host while an agent drives it.

#### A.5.3 Exact commands (PowerShell; the primary shell)

```powershell
$UE  = "C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8"          # verified: Build.bat, RunUAT.bat, UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe, UnrealEditor.exe present
$WT  = "D:\Hackathons\hayba\.worktrees\p0-safety"
$H   = "D:\UEScratch\h58"                             # throwaway host; NEVER under D:\UnrealEngine
$SHA = git -C $WT rev-parse --short HEAD

# T0.1 once: minimal C++ host
#   $H\h58.uproject  = {"FileVersion":3,"EngineAssociation":"5.8","Modules":[{"Name":"h58","Type":"Runtime","LoadingPhase":"Default"}],
#                       "Plugins":[{"Name":"HaybaMCPToolkit","Enabled":true},{"Name":"HaybaMCPMetaSound","Enabled":true},{"Name":"HaybaMCPGAS","Enabled":true},
#                                  {"Name":"Metasound","Enabled":true},{"Name":"GameplayAbilities","Enabled":true},{"Name":"PythonScriptPlugin","Enabled":true},
#                                  {"Name":"PCG","Enabled":true},{"Name":"EditorScriptingUtilities","Enabled":true}]}
#   $H\Source\h58.Target.cs, $H\Source\h58Editor.Target.cs (BuildSettingsVersion.Latest, EngineIncludeOrderVersion.Latest, ExtraModuleNames.Add("h58")),
#   $H\Source\h58\h58.Build.cs, $H\Source\h58\h58.cpp (IMPLEMENT_PRIMARY_GAME_MODULE(FDefaultGameModuleImpl, h58, "h58");)
#   No World Partition map is needed: BatchPumpStopsWhileUnsafe injects a region that counts as loaded (decided in T1.4),
#   and BatchHoldsDuringPIE uses ping steps.
#   No Config\DefaultHaybaMCP.ini (R-26).

# Sync: COPY, never symlink; keep built Binaries/Intermediate
foreach ($p in "HaybaMCPToolkit","HaybaMCPMetaSound","HaybaMCPGAS") {
  robocopy "$WT\unreal\$p" "$H\Plugins\$p" /MIR /XD Binaries Intermediate /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS | Out-Null
}

# Strict standalone compile (deploy gates). Reads the worktree only.
& "$UE\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\RunUAT.bat" BuildPlugin `
  -Plugin="$WT\unreal\HaybaMCPToolkit\HaybaMCPToolkit.uplugin" `
  -Package="D:\UEScratch\out\p0-$SHA\HaybaMCPToolkit" -TargetPlatforms=Win64

# Host build (twice after adding a .cpp)
& "$UE\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat" h58Editor Win64 Development -Project="$H\h58.uproject" -WaitMutex

# Full headless run, with the same flags the plugin's owned children use, plus a watchdog
$args = @("`"$H\h58.uproject`"", "-unattended","-nop4","-nullrhi","-nosplash","-nosound","-stdout","-FullStdOutLogOutput",
          "-HaybaAutomationChild=p0scratch",
          "-ReportExportPath=`"D:\UEScratch\reports\$SHA`"",
          "-ExecCmds=`"Automation List;RunTests Hayba;Quit`"",
          "-TestExit=`"Automation Test Queue Empty`"",
          "-log=hayba-p0-$SHA.log")
$proc = Start-Process "$UE\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe" -ArgumentList $args -PassThru
if (-not $proc.WaitForExit(3600*1000)) {
  Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*UEScratch\h58\h58.uproject*" } |
    ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force }      # scratch only; never a consumer editor
}

# Exact-name verification
node "$WT\mcp-tools\hayba-mcp\scripts\check-automation-report.mjs" `
  "D:\UEScratch\reports\$SHA\index.json" "$WT\mcp-tools\hayba-mcp\scripts\p0-expected-automation-tests.txt" `
  --allow-fail Hayba.MCP.UI.RenderWidgetToPng
# Cross-check the log (results are not on stdout)
(Select-String -Path "$H\Saved\Logs\hayba-p0-$SHA.log" -Pattern 'Result=\{Success\}').Count
Select-String -Path "$H\Saved\Logs\hayba-p0-$SHA.log" -Pattern 'Result=\{Fail\}'

# Real PIE (opt-in, separate invocation)
#   same args, with -ExecCmds="Automation RunTests Hayba.MCP.State.RealPIE;Quit" -HaybaRealPIETests

# LNK1104: kill only the process whose command line names $H

# TS gate
Set-Location "$WT\mcp-tools\hayba-mcp"
npx tsc --noEmit; npx vitest run; npm run lint:legacy-wrappers; npm run build:server

# Host kit (T4 onward)
Set-Location $WT; python -m pytest <host-kit>/tests -q
```

Notes:
- **`-ExecCmds` form:** one leading `Automation`, with subcommands split on `;` (`AutomationCommandline.cpp:582`, verified on 5.8). `Automation List; Automation RunTests …` runs nothing.
- **The prior 5.7 BuildPlugin failed** (`D:/UEScratch/logs/toolkit-buildplugin.log`). Only 5.8 is a valid gate.
- **Report format:** `index.json` holds `tests[]` with `fullTestPath`/`FullTestPath`, `state`/`State` and a per-test `warnings` count (the keys `HaybaMCPTestHandler.cpp:429-446` reads). The checker accepts only the state `Success` for a manifest name (spec §6.2) and prints warning counts as information. The plugin's own `test_run` parse also accepts `SuccessWithWarnings`, which UE 5.8 never writes as a per-test state.

#### A.5.4 Live verification ladder

All steps run on the scratch GUI host only, by the port its heartbeat names, from an external client. Never from `python_run`.

Launch `& "$UE\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor.exe" "$H\h58.uproject"` only when no other `UnrealEditor*` process names `$H`, and after noting any consumer editor's port.

**Deploy A (GA.2):**
1. **A1:** `ping` shows `capabilities.editor_health`, `editor_unsafe:false`, `health`.
2. **A2:** `editor_get_state {include_dirty:false}` returns `pie:"none"`, `building:[]` and the health fields.
3. **A3:** Press Play by hand. `editor_get_state.pie` is `"user"`. `blueprint_add_node` gets `pie_active` (check the log: one Warning, then a limited count). `editor_stop_pie` from a raw connection is refused.
4. **A4:** Stop, then `editor_start_pie` from raw conn A. `pie` is `"agent:conn:<A>"`. `editor_pie_press_key` from conn B gets `pie_active`. `editor_stop_pie` from conn B succeeds, with a Warning naming both owners.
5. **A5:** `lease_acquire {resources:["asset:/Game/__HaybaTest__/BP_Busy"], ttl_s:15, bind_connection:false, label:"build:ladder"}` as owner `builder`. `editor_start_pie` as `lane5` gets `asset_busy`. The handle is still redacted before T4, so let it lapse.
6. **A6:** A Blueprint in `BS_Error`: `editor_start_pie` gets `pie_blocked` and no modal opens.
7. **A7:** Trigger a live fault via the Python corruption marker (R-15). The persistent notification is visible. The log has the Error line plus `user notified … frame N`, with N ≤ fault frame + 1. `python_run` gets `editor_unsafe_restart_required`. `ping`, `editor_get_state` and `lease_status` answer. Press Play: vetoed with the unsafe text.
8. **A8:** Restart the scratch editor. The state is clean.

**Deploy B (GB.2), per spec §6.5:**
1. **B1:** `ping` shows `caps.lease_id`, `lease_enforcement:"enforced_for_writes"`, `owner_required`.
2. **B2:** acquire, then `ls_` id, renew by `lease_id`, renew `{}`, `editor_batch {lease_id, steps:[ping]}` reaches `succeeded`, release, and zero `unknown or expired` lines.
3. **B3:** A read-only Blueprint: `blueprint_compile {save:true}` refuses with the hint; `{save:false}` compiles.
4. **B4:** A read-only map with `python_run` `save_current_level()` returns `False` **without a modal**. The GUI is not `-unattended`, so this is the real check (R-3).
5. **B5:** `level_save` on a read-only map refuses without a modal.
6. **B6:** A Node client via `UE_TCP_PORT` with `HAYBA_AGENT_ID`, left idle for 10 s: the lease is orphaned and revived by `lease_renew {}`. This confirms the 5 s drop.
7. **B7:** Project Settings set to Advisory and back. `ping` reports each mode at once.
8. **B8:** T10: a build lease held by another owner, then press Play: vetoed. A second press within 10 s plays. Then `hayba.PIEBuildVeto 0` gives a notification only.
9. **B9:** Two owners: A holds global X; B's `material_set_param` gets `lease_conflict`. An owner-less write gets `owner_required`.
10. **B10:** Per-call raw pass (R-9): 50 identical conflicting calls produce one Warning line plus the drained "repeated" line.

**Deploy C (GC.2):**
1. **C1:** `lease_adopt` switches the connection owner.
2. **C2:** A raw envelope claiming `conn:<other>` gets `owner_reserved`.
3. **C3:** A batch owned by `conn:N` keeps running its steps after N closes.

#### A.5.5 Handoff docs (GA.3, GB.3, GC.3)

`docs/handoffs/HANDOFF-p0-deploy-{a,b,c}-consumer.md`. These are text for the consumer's session to act on in its own closed-editor window. Hayba never builds into or edits `<project>`.

Each handoff contains:
1. The tag and commit, and the `<deploy-branch>` merge commit.
2. The Node `dist/` built from the same commit.
3. Preconditions:
   - **A:** the user knows the notification (§5.1 bullet 1); the bpgraph lease step is recommended (§5.1); the rule "no `editor_gate.py acquire --scope asset:` before B".
   - **B:** the full §5.2 checklist items 1–12 with tests green; `HAYBA_AGENT_ID` per lane; no `HAYBA_LEASE` in MCP server env; D7 = approved, mode 1.
   - **C:** §5.3.
4. The window procedure (§7.2 step 2–3):
   1. Announce.
   2. `editor_gate.py acquire --owner deploy` (global).
   3. The user saves and closes.
   4. Build through the existing deploy-branch path, never `robocopy /MIR` into `<project>/Plugins`.
   5. MetaSound only once installed (D6).
5. Post-restart verification (§7.2 step 4).
6. Rollback: the live Advisory setting; the ini fallback with its section header; `hayba.PIEBuildVeto 0`; redeploy the previous tag.
7. The exit-code table (0–6) and the §5.1 host changes (A) or §5.2 changes (B).
8. The M1–M8 measurement recipe, with the limiter's `(+N identical …)` and `repeated N more times` sums for M2.
9. The known limits: R-1 (what stays undeclared), R-23, R-24.
